findings.description: The KMS key does not define an explicit key policy, so it falls back to the default AWS policy granting full access (kms:*) to the account root and, by extension, any IAM principal granted broad IAM permissions, rather than a scoped least-privilege policy for this audit-trail key. It also does not set enable_key_rotation, so automatic annual key rotation is disabled, leaving the same cryptographic material in use indefinitely and weakening defence-in-depth for a key protecting sensitive audit trail data.
